facts.fact: The Senate ratified on 13 March 2026 a presidential ordinance reforming ANSICE, the national agency for information security, broadening its mandate over cybersecurity and other digital matters.

systems.country_label: Agence Nationale de Sécurité Informatique et de Certification Électronique (ANSICE)

note: Work on a national cybersecurity strategy was launched in December 2022 but no adoption is stated; a classification of entities of vital digital importance is introduced by law, not a designation.
